question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing cheerleader, Bob is playing striker, Claire is playing right midfielder, Dave is playing center midfielder, Eve is playing benchwarmer, Fred is playing right back, and Gertrude is playing left back.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Dave and Alice trade positions. Then, Gertrude and Dave trade positions. Then, Alice and Claire trade positions. Then, Dave and Eve trade positions. Then, Gertrude and Fred trade positions. Then, Claire and Eve trade positions. Finally, Gertrude and Dave trade positions. At the end of the match, Gertrude is playing
Options:
(A) cheerleader
(B) striker
(C) right midfielder
(D) center midfielder
(E) benchwarmer
(F) right back
(G) left back
solution:
Each row lists positions in the order (Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude).
Initial: (cheerleader, striker, right midfielder, center midfielder, benchwarmer, right back, left back)
1. Swap Dave and Alice: (center midfielder, striker, right midfielder, cheerleader, benchwarmer, right back, left back)
2. Swap Gertrude and Dave: (center midfielder, striker, right midfielder, left back, benchwarmer, right back, cheerleader)
3. Swap Alice and Claire: (right midfielder, striker, center midfielder, left back, benchwarmer, right back, cheerleader)
4. Swap Dave and Eve: (right midfielder, striker, center midfielder, benchwarmer, left back, right back, cheerleader)
5. Swap Gertrude and Fred: (right midfielder, striker, center midfielder, benchwarmer, left back, cheerleader, right back)
6. Swap Claire and Eve: (right midfielder, striker, left back, benchwarmer, center midfielder, cheerleader, right back)
7. Swap Gertrude and Dave: (right midfielder, striker, left back, right back, center midfielder, cheerleader, benchwarmer)
Gertrude is the benchwarmer, option (E).
Final answer: (E)
